scope: Independent native XML oracle and controls for the existing seven-file slide arrangement corpus; no production changes and no additional native-render claim.
toolchain: Flutter 3.44.0 / Dart 3.12.0; Python standard library only
checks: Exact authored source bytes, including a pinned fixture fingerprint
One native slide and five literal named shape coordinates, extents and text values
Two ordered flat groups and the fifth shape outside groups
Unique numeric uint32 IDs including native root, groups and shapes
Identity container transforms, with no rotation or reflection
Stable native identities and membership across three direct and three isolate saves
negative_controls: Root/group and group/shape duplicate IDs, including different decimal spelling
Duplicate shape IDs and values outside uint32
Changed position, extent, text, or shape name
Wrong group membership, grouping of the ungrouped shape, changed draw order and nesting
Nonidentity group translation and shape rotation
Valid ZIP whose bytes no longer match the authored source
Missing save, unexpected nested export, and legal but unstable later-cycle identity
